daily.topThemeTitle: Foreign Cyberattacks Target Academic Research Blogs
daily.topThemeBody: Inside Higher Ed reports a wave of cyberattacks on British academic blogs that researchers believe is tied to authoritarian regimes trying to shut down work documenting human-rights abuses, adding a geopolitical edge to campus cybersecurity threats.

heroWeek.themeTitle: Fall Conference Calendar Fills In From a Sept. 23 Virtual Kickoff to EDUCAUSE
heroWeek.themeBody: The virtual Tech Tactics in Education opens September 23, EDUCAUSE's annual conference follows September 29, 1EdTech's CBExchange runs September 30-October 3, and ISTE has opened proposals for ISTELive 27 in Boston -- all ahead of EdTech Week's October return to Columbia.
